title: Campbell Rhea
description: campbellrhea.com Campbell Rhea US manufacturer of laboratory and educational casework — legal entity Institutional Casework, Inc. (ICI) — with roots to 1951 in Paris, TN. The brand survived a 2005 tornado that destroyed its former parent Mohon International, was relaunched by local investors in 2006 (CEO Jim Arthurs ever since), and acquired Jamestown Metal Products (NY) plus a steel plant in Union City, TN — 650,000 sq ft of manufacturing total. Products: wood/steel/stainless lab casework, ISOLATOR fume hoods, countertops, athletic lockers (Olympian), Patriot tables — certified SEFA-8, FSC, AIA CES. Revenue $32.1M (2025) per FDMC 300, down from a $63.5M COVID-era peak (2022); ~250 employees, 35+ US dealers, projects at Penn State, UC Davis, Vanderbilt, Case Western, U of Missouri.
